company.name: Hollydesk
company.shortDescription: Hollydesk is a platform that manages SME company's daily expenses and accounts payable from end to end.
company.description: Holydesk help employees in submitting work-related invoiced and getting paid in no time, while keeping organization financial records clean.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that allows employees to upload receipts, managers to approve or decline expenses, and finance teams to track and process payments and invoices in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Expense Management

productsAndServices.description: Automated real-time reporting that provides insights into company spending, allowing for better budget control and decision-making.
productsAndServices.name: Real-time Reporting

productsAndServices.description: A system to register suppliers, upload their documents, approve and pay their invoices digitally, and track and export all related data.
productsAndServices.name: Supplier Management

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides immediate funding for cash flow, with an expandable credit limit based on spending, and real-time tracking of all payments.
productsAndServices.name: Business Credit

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows employees to get reimbursed for out-of-pocket expenses quickly by uploading receipts and getting instant approval and payment.
productsAndServices.name: Expense Reimbursements

productsAndServices.description: A service where employees can request funds in advance for work-related expenses, with instant transfer upon approval and easy reconciliation.
productsAndServices.name: In Advance Payment

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,076,280 to $5,482,407, a 5.09x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 30 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include BILL, SAP Concur, Ramp.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
